requirements.text: We are looking for an experienced data scientist with expertise analyzing medical and life science data to join us as a member of our team. You will be making mission-critical contributions to Character’s drug discovery and development programs by leveraging our multi-modality dataset to support the identification of new therapeutic targets and inform our clinical trial design strategy. You will have responsibility for determining and implementing scientific and analytical methodologies, for providing data-driven guidance to cross-functional teams, and to contribute to the continued improvement of Character’s data platform. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a lean, fast-moving environment and enjoys tackling scientifically interesting problems using unique multimodality data.
PhD in Statistics, Data Science or a related technical field
1–3 years of professional experience applying statistical and data science methods to real-world healthcare data (e.g.,claims, EMR, or other observational data)

Hands-on experience analyzing biomedical imaging data, ideally retinal imaging such as optical coherence tomography (OCT), fundus autofluorescence, or fundus photography (experience with other modalities such as MRI, CT, or histopathology/IHC is also relevant)
A strong statistician's grounding combined with hands-on software skills: comfortable writing production-quality

Deep knowledge of machine learning and statistical methods, including survival/time-to-event analysis, mixed-effects modeling, and Bayesian methods (an area we are looking to expand further, particularly within our genetic analyses)
Experience developing longitudinal models on biomedical data, particularly real-world data including electronic medical records (EMRs) and/or claims data
Experience developing and implementing data analysis software modules and tools as part of data pipelines and to enable interactive analysis
Strong problem-solving skills, with a focus on using data to drive action and decision making
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work cross functionally in a team-oriented environments
Experience developing and deploying encoder-based deep learning models in production.
Experience with ophthalmology data, particularly clinical data related to AMD or Glaucoma
Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States.
